title: Dashboard request → migration control flow
answers: How does a dashboard GET request flow through storage and migration?
Where is schema-version migration invoked for a dashboard?
How are app manifests registered into the server?
body:
App manifest (SDK-generated): apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard_manifest.go:57 appManifestData, exposed via LocalManifest()/RemoteManifest() (~:1026/:1030) — lists versions/kinds/routes/search-fields.
HTTP registration: pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/register.go:111 DashboardsAPIBuilder implements builder.APIGroupBuilder; register.go:147 RegisterAPIService calls apiregistration.RegisterAPI. Wired into server DI at pkg/server/bootstrap/wire/wire_gen.go:945 (dashboard.RegisterAPIService(...)).
REST storage: DashboardsAPIBuilder.UpdateAPIGroupInfo (register.go:1046) registers per-version rest.Storage via storageForVersion (register.go:1197), wrapped by dashboardStorageWrapper (pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/dashboard_storage.go:24). dto subresource: sub_dto.go:40 NewDTOConnector / sub_dto.go:84 Connect.
GET-as-DTO path: HTTP → DTOConnector.Connect (sub_dto.go:84) → dashboardStorageWrapper → grafanaregistry.NewRegistryStore → pkg/storage/unified/resource.ResourceClient. If stored version != requested version, conversion.RegisterConversions (register.go:321) invokes apps/dashboard/pkg/migration/migrate.go:77 Migrate(ctx, dash, targetVersion), which runs schemaversion.GetMigrations() (apps/dashboard/pkg/migration/schemaversion/migrations.go:53) up to LATEST_VERSION (migrations.go:12, currently 42), producing a DashboardWithAccessInfo DTO.
